description: This file defines a React context provider component (CanonicalStoreProvider) that manages shared state for canonical course data, including fetching, updating, and syncing with backend services. It exports a React context hook (useCanonicalStore) for consuming this context in child components.

methods.name: CanonicalStoreProvider
methods.description: React component that provides the canonical store context, managing synchronization with backend and exposing state and methods to child components.

methods.name: useCanonicalStore
methods.description: Custom hook to consume the CanonicalStore context within React components.
